## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the contribution rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/docs/contributing.md)

- [ ] `npm run test` passes locally (or new tests added for the change)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change is user-visible
